name: Nemo Stats: Throwables
description:
Tunes the armory throwables' counts, explosion damage, and radii.

Overall better ammo economy for low-end grenades.

- G-12 High Explosive
  Nukes short radius.
- G-16 Impact
  Nukes short radius but on impact.
- G-50 Seeker
  Nukes short radius but self-propelled, lower count.
- G-6 Frag
  Many shrapnel pellets.
  Big theoretical damage, but unreliable.
- G-7 Pineapple
  Large area cleanup cluster grenade.
- G-123 Thermite
  Destroys single target.
- G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker
  Destroys single target but self propelled.
- G-48 Giga Grenade
  Nukes large area, low count.
- G-10 Incendiary
  Medium area denial with explosion.
- G-13 Incendiary Impact
  Medium area denial with explosion but on impact.
- G-8 Immolation
  Large area denial without explosion.
- G-142 Pyrotech
  Small area denial, anti tank.
- G-23 Stun
  Large area.
  Stuns even big enemies.
- G-109 Urchin
  Large area. Stuns even big enemies. Sticks to enemy/terrain.
- G-31 Arc
  Area denial with more arks.
- G-3 Smoke
  Obscure large area.
- G-89 Smokescreen
  Obscure large area but on impact.
- TM-1 Lure Mine
  Nukes large area.
- G/40-K Melta Mine
  Nukes medium area but anti-tank.
- G/SH-39 Shield
  Larger radius and health.
